content: Oseltamivir is supplied in the following forms: 1. Tamiflu Capsules: 30 mg Capsules: These contain 30 mg of oseltamivir free base equivalent to the phosphate salt. The capsules are light yellow, hard gelatin capsules. The word ROCHE is printed in blue ink on the light yellow body, and 30 mg is printed in blue ink on the light yellow cap. They are available in blister packages of 10 capsules (NDC 0004-0802-85). 45 mg Capsules: These contain 45 mg of oseltamivir free base equivalent to the phosphate salt. The capsules are grey, hard gelatin capsules. The word ROCHE is printed in blue ink on the grey body, and 45 mg is printed in blue ink on the grey cap. They are available in blister packages of 10 capsules (NDC 0004-0801-85). 75 mg Capsules: These contain 75 mg of oseltamivir free base equivalent to the phosphate salt. The capsules are grey and light yellow, hard gelatin capsules. The word ROCHE is printed in blue ink on the grey body, and 75 mg is printed in blue ink on the light yellow cap. They are available in blister packages of 10 capsules (NDC 0004-0800-85). Storage Instructions for Capsules: Store the capsules at 25°C (77°F). Temperature excursions are permitted between 15°C and 30°C (59°F to 86°F). 2. Tamiflu for Oral Suspension: This is supplied as a white powder blend in a glass bottle. After reconstitution with 55 mL of water, the powder produces a white, tutti-frutti-flavored oral suspension. Each bottle delivers a usable volume of 60 mL of oral suspension, equivalent to 360 mg of oseltamivir base (6 mg/mL). (NDC 0004-0822-05). Storage Instructions for Oral Suspension: Store the dry powder at 25°C (77°F). Temperature excursions are permitted between 15°C and 30°C (59°F to 86°F). After reconstitution, store the suspension under refrigeration at 2°C to 8°C (36°F to 46°F) for up to 17 days. Do not freeze the reconstituted suspension.
